thread:
hannah: Uploaded two variants for the Usage & Billing page: compact cards (2-up) and vertical list (rows). Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz789 — need quick pros/cons, especially around discoverability for invoice downloads and token breakdowns.

diego: Quick skim: compact cards give a better high-level scan for orgs with few workspaces. But for teams with 50+ workspaces the vertical list scales better.

emma: UX note: If we show token breakdown per card, do we show absolute counts or percentages? Percentages are faster to read but hide scale (e.g., 1 vs 10k tokens). Maybe show both: small % + hover for exact numbers.

hannah: Good call. Thinking small stacked-mini-chart at top-right of each card (8px bars) and on hover show tooltip with exact tokens last 30d.

a11y-bot: Tooltip accessibility reminder: tooltips must be focusable and dismissible with Esc, and have role="tooltip" linked to the trigger via aria-describedby. Also color contrast: chip text on accent backgrounds flagged.

diego: For downloads: inline per-card CTA increases click targets but hurts density. Another option: select mode (checkbox per row/card) + top-level "Download invoices" bulk action. That solves both discoverability and clutter.

emma: Select mode adds complexity but is familiar pattern. We should keep a lightweight affordance on each item to quickly download latest invoice (ellipsis menu -> Download). Bulk download in header for multi-select.

hannah: Agree. Also wanting a persistent scope selector (Org / Project) that doesn't cause content jump. Proposal: sticky toolbar under main nav that keeps height constant.

design-bot: Visual regression check: switching from Org -> Project currently animates content height; suggest using cross-fade to avoid layout shift.

a11y-bot: Keyboard nav: If cards are used, arrow-key navigation should be implemented (roving tabindex) and screen reader users should be able to move between items with next/previous shortcuts. Provide skip link to jump to first card.

diego: Performance note: rendering tiny svg sparklines for every card caused 2x paint time on dashboard with 300 cards in testing. Recommendation: pre-render PNG tiles server-side or batch-draw on a single offscreen canvas and reuse.

emma: Copy nit for per-item menu: change "Download" -> "Download invoice (CSV)" and add secondary line under workspace name: "Last billed: Mar 15 • $34.12" to reduce surprise.

hannah: I'll update the frames: cards variant with checkbox + ellipsis menu + microchart via rasterized asset; list variant with inline actions + pagination. We'll run a small usability test with 6 users (power and novice) next week.

diego: For mobile, list wins for ergonomics; cards only for tablets and desktop. Also ensure touch targets meet 44px min.

a11y-bot: Contrast re-check after color updates. Also confirm the focus ring is visible against the new blue on hover.

emma: OK — I'll draft the copy for tooltips, aria-labels, and bulk CTA text and drop in Figma comments. Example aria-label: "Download invoice for workspace Acme — CSV".

hannah: Thanks all. Please add any dev constraints here if you have them; planning to finalize in tomorrow's design crit. :rocket:
